mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ambush</titleLeft><mainText>Twitch has ambushed and has gained increased <attackspeed>attack speed</attackspeed></mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Deadly Venom</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is poisoned and taking damage over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Deadly Venom</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is poisoned and taking damage over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Deadly Venom</titleLeft><mainText>Twitch's basic attacks infect his target, dealing <font color='#ffffff'>@f1@</font> true damage per second for @f2@ seconds, stacking up to @f3@ times. <font color='#a3554e'>(Max Tick Damage: @f1*6@)</font></mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit>, dealing true damage each second.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Twitch's Attacks infect his target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing @DamagePerSecond@ true damage per second for @Duration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times.

Max Damage Per Second: @DamagePerSecondMax@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Deals @BaseDamage@ physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom, plus an additional @PhysicalDamagePerStack@ physical damage and @MagicDamagePerStack@ magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom.

Max Damage: @MaxPhysicalDamage@ physical damage and @MaxMagicDamage@ magical damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining @BonusRange@ Attack Range and @BonusAD@ Attack Damage, and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for @Duration@ seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal @FallOffDamage*100@% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of @MinimumFallOffDamage*100@% damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Using this Ability does not break <keywordStealth>Camouflage</keywordStealth>, but Attacking still does.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Spray and Pray</titleLeft><mainText>Twitch's attacks are long ranged and pass through units.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Ambush</titleLeft><mainText>Twitch is <font color='#cd90ee'>Camouflaged</font> and has increased Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.

When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Twitch Camouflages and gains @MoveSpeedMod@% Move Speed for @StealthDuration@ seconds. The Move Speed increases to @HiddenSpeed@% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains @AttackSpeedMod*100@% Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.

When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Improved Ambush Available</titleLeft><mainText>Twitch can quickly drop into Camouflage with Ambush.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for @Duration@ seconds.

Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by @TotalSlowAmount@% and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Venom Cask Slow</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move Speed is reduced.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
